source_screens.rules: Goal cannot rewrite measured skill

source_screens.rules: Placement optional; missing evidence allowed

source_screens.states: Ready, selected, validation-error, submitting, result, skipped-domain, audio-unavailable

source_screens.purpose: Show provisional starting state and uncertainty
source_screens.rules: Qualitative/provisional language only

source_screens.purpose: Answer what to do next and why
source_screens.rules: Reason copy must match logged reason; no risk/mastery percentage

source_screens.name: Home Offline
source_screens.purpose: Home with offline status and device-saved distinction
source_screens.rules: Queued is not server-confirmed

source_screens.name: Home Syncing
source_screens.purpose: Show background synchronization without blocking navigation
source_screens.rules: No duplicate progress/reward from retries

source_screens.name: Learn Hub
source_screens.purpose: Start or resume finite learning cycle
source_screens.rules: No infinite feed

source_screens.name: Cycle Intro
source_screens.purpose: Show objective, reason and approximate duration
source_screens.rules: ~5 min is configurable hypothesis; objective/reason explicit

source_screens.name: Review Item
source_screens.rules: Blank submit is impossible; Skip is explicit and creates no completion/mastery.

source_screens.name: Learn Content
source_screens.rules: Reading explanation alone is not mastery

source_screens.name: Retrieve Item
source_screens.states: Ready, selected, hinted, submitted-result, retry-available, retry-exhausted, skipped
source_screens.rules: First response is preserved; assisted flag persists independently of feedback; one retry is the current configurable policy.

source_screens.name: Transfer Item
source_screens.rules: Blank submit is impossible; transfer is within objective and does not change level.

source_screens.name: Check Intro
source_screens.rules: No pre-submit hint in Check

source_screens.name: Check Item
source_screens.states: Ready, selected, validation-error, submitting, result, audio-ready, audio-unavailable, play-limit-reached
source_screens.rules: No pre-submit hint; blank submit impossible; Check has no practice retry; listening play requests are client telemetry only.

source_screens.name: Correct Feedback
source_screens.rules: Reward/copy cannot imply validated mastery from one answer

source_screens.name: Incorrect / Retry Feedback
source_screens.purpose: Explain error and offer practice retry where policy allows
source_screens.states: Retry available, retry used, retry exhausted
source_screens.rules: Retry correct never overwrites first wrong

source_screens.name: Hint Panel
source_screens.rules: Hint use marks evidence assisted

source_screens.name: Skip Confirmation
source_screens.purpose: Confirm skip without shame or false completion
source_screens.rules: Skip != completion/mastery/streak

source_screens.name: Cycle Summary
source_screens.purpose: Explicit closure, practiced evidence and next step
source_screens.rules: No fake mastery %; user explicitly starts another cycle

source_screens.name: Resume Cycle
source_screens.rules: No duplicate submit on resume

source_screens.name: Course Map
source_screens.rules: Preview does not unlock/progress

source_screens.name: Objective Detail
source_screens.rules: Prerequisite guardrail remains authoritative

source_screens.name: Locked Preview
source_screens.rules: Preview cannot create evidence, progress, completion, prerequisite bypass or unlock.

source_screens.name: Profile
source_screens.purpose: Goal, qualitative learning evidence and settings entry
source_screens.rules: Engagement/streak not presented as mastery

source_screens.name: Evidence Detail
source_screens.purpose: Show observations, uncertainty and missing evidence
source_screens.rules: No diagnosis or precise mastery percentage without validated model

source_screens.name: Goal Settings
source_screens.rules: Goal change does not rewrite competence

source_screens.name: Learning Preferences
source_screens.rules: Preference cannot bypass required eligibility rules

source_screens.name: Offline Downloads
source_screens.rules: Access grant/package rules remain server-authoritative

source_screens.name: Sync Queue
source_screens.purpose: Explain queued/synced items without technical jargon
source_screens.rules: Connectivity and server acknowledgement are distinct; Synced appears only after authoritative acknowledgement/canonical refresh.

source_screens.name: Sync Error
source_screens.rules: Recovery reuses durable command identity; local state never overwrites server truth.

source_screens.name: Generic Error
source_screens.rules: No false success state

source_screens.name: Nothing Due / Content Gap
source_screens.rules: Do not fabricate cycle/recommendation

source_screens.name: Re-auth Required
source_screens.rules: Phase 3 implements auth; no local permission bypass

source_screens.name: Staff Entry
source_screens.rules: Actual authentication/authorization belongs Phase 3

source_screens.name: Dashboard
source_screens.rules: Metrics must identify time range/source

source_screens.name: Learner List
source_screens.rules: Role visibility is not authorization

source_screens.name: Learner Overview
source_screens.rules: No mental-state diagnosis; raw risk not default to content admin

source_screens.name: Learner Evidence
source_screens.rules: Mastery != risk; uncertainty visible

source_screens.name: Learner Activity
source_screens.rules: Historical revision pinning preserved

source_screens.name: Content Library
source_screens.rules: Published revision immutable

source_screens.name: Content Preview
source_screens.rules: Preview has no publish/progress side effect.

source_screens.name: Source & License
source_screens.rules: Publication stays blocked until provenance/license requirement passes.

source_screens.rules: Reviewer actions require later server permission

source_screens.name: Review Detail
source_screens.rules: Approve is disabled until provenance/license gate passes.
